items.headline: Utah extends longest active winning streak in FBS, clinches Big 12 title bid
items.description: Devon Dampier threw a 68-yard touchdown pass before halftime and an 85-yard clincher in the fourth quarter as No. 2 Utah beat TCU 38-17 for its 17th straight victory, clinching a spot in the Big 12 championship game.

items.headline: Chaos takes over the Big Ten: UCLA, Indiana and Ohio State all lose in Week 12
items.description: UCLA, Indiana and Ohio State all lost to unranked teams in a year where parity is the ever-present theme.

items.headline: Dampier throws 2 long TD passes as No. 2 Utah beats TCU 38-17 to clinch spot in Big 12 title game
items.description: — Devon Dampier threw a 68-yard touchdown pass before halftime and an 85-yard clincher in the fourth quarter as No. 2 Utah beat TCU 38-17 on Saturday night for its 17th straight victory, clinching a spot in the Big 12 championship game.
